Know a project that belongs on one of the maps but don't want to open a
PR yourself? The [/submit/](https://awesomemap.dev/submit/) page on the
site fills this in for you — or just fill it in by hand below. Either
way, this is fully automatic: opening this issue kicks off
`scripts/process-submission.mjs`, which classifies it, and either commits
it or closes with a reason, usually within a few minutes — no maintainer
step. Already comfortable editing JSON? A PR (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)) is faster and skips this
entirely.

**Project**

<!-- GitHub repo URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo -->

**Which map should it go in?**

<!-- One of: AI, Data Science, Databases, DevOps & Infra, Mobile Dev,
     Security, IoT & Smart Home, Web Dev, Automation — or "not sure" if
     you're not certain which fits best. -->

**Why it fits**

<!-- A sentence or two: what does it do, and why does it belong here?
     Real, actively maintained projects only — forks, archived repos, and
     personal toy projects don't make the cut. -->
